label: RUCKUS ICX 7150-C10ZP
description: RUCKUS ICX 7150-C10ZP fanless multigigabit compact switch: 8x 1G/2.5G RJ-45 plus 2x 1/2.5/5/10G RJ-45 uplinks, all ten PoE (240 W budget, four of them 802.3bt-ready PoH at up to 90 W), and 2x 1/10G SFP+ uplink/stacking.

poe.note: 240 W PoE budget across 10 PoE ports; up to 90 W per port on four PoH 802.3bt-ready ports (the datasheet does not state which four).

notes: Hardware guide model table: 8x 1G/2.5G copper downlinks, 10 PoE ports, 240 W, 2x 1G/2.5G/10G copper uplinks plus 2xSFP+ uplink/stacking. Datasheet: 10x RJ-45 multigigabit ports, including 8x 2.5 GbE and 2x 2.5/5/10 GbE, 2x 1/10 GbE uplink/stacking SFP/SFP+, 240 W PoE budget, up to 90 W per port on 4 PoH 802.3bt-ready ports, fanless. All ten copper ports are PoE (the model table says 10 of 10), so all ten are modelled as PSE at the 802.3at class; the datasheet says up to 90 W on four 802.3bt-ready PoH ports but does not say WHICH four, so this spec records the 240 W budget and the four-port PoH capability here rather than assigning 90 W to ports by guesswork - on the 48ZP the guide does name the ports (the first 16) and there the 90 W figure is modelled per port. PoD licensing guide: 1/3/1 and 1/3/2 are the licence-gated 10G uplinks.
